name: four-legged walk cycle
rules: Side view facing right; the creature keeps exactly the same size and design in every cell; the stone shell plates are rigid.
The head lags one frame behind the body; the stubby tail moves on its own rhythm.
Heavy creature: very small bounce, slow wind-ups, long recoveries.

Four-beat lateral walk: the legs land in the order near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore; at least two hooves are always on the ground line; a lifted hoof rises only 1-2 pixels; the body bobs 1 pixel at most.
The creature walks IN PLACE (no travel across the cell): planted hooves slide backward under the body.

frames.pose: reference: the original standing pose, unchanged
near hind leg planted forward under the belly, far front leg lifting
near front leg planted forward, near hind leg pushed back, body 1 pixel lower
far hind leg planted forward, near front leg pushed back
far front leg planted forward, far hind leg pushed back, body 1 pixel lower
near hind leg lifting and swinging forward, other three hooves on the ground
near front leg lifting and swinging forward, body back up
far hind leg lifting and swinging forward
far front leg lifting and swinging forward, body 1 pixel lower
